messages:
taylor_csm: FYI: OrionData activity sank ~68% over last 2 weeks, main champion Lydia left on Fri. Procurement has started a short pilot with GraftAI. flagging as renewal-risk, need quick triage :warning:
aj_sales: ugh. thanks for flagging. do we have the usage graph + top-team contacts? want to know if this is just Lydia or org-level churn :eyes:
priya_cs: I can take lead on outreach. recommend short enablement refresher + 30m playbook session for the new ML lead. can we get a sample of their top prompts + current model config? :wave:
marcus_eng: I'll pull infra/latency errors but nothing obvious on our side in the last 30d. running a quick query now:
marcus_eng: ```sql
SELECT day, tokens_generated, active_users
FROM usage
WHERE account_id = 'oriondata'
AND day >= '2026-02-01'
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 60;
```
ops_bot: Analytics snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/oriondata/usage (last 14d: -68% tokens, active seats 12 -> 4) :chart_with_downwards_trend:
taylor_csm: thanks marcus + bot. aj, any notes from the sales cadence? were procurement conversations already leaning Dedicated or Private?
aj_sales: procurement asked about on-prem option (security) and cost per token. GraftAI's pilot is looking cheaper on first pass, focusing on throughput. we lost contact with Lydia last week, new ML lead is "Marco R." (cc in CRM).
priya_cs: immediate next steps I propose: 1) 48h reconnect email from me + aj offering a 20m enablement; 2) share a short remediation play: usage checklist, cost-optimization tips, quick batch settings; 3) offer a free canary on Dedicated for 2 weeks (if sales ok).
taylor_csm: agree. aj can you authorize a 2-week dedicated canary discount? sales ok with a short trial incentive to win back trust?
aj_sales: can do promo credit instead of discount — easier legal. I'll greenlight up to $5k in credits if CS gets commitment for enablement and exec sync.
marcus_eng: to support enablement, I'll export a diff of request latency and model variants used. also suggest we precompute suggestions to lower token usage (prefix caching + partial-compile).
priya_cs: scheduling: I'll ping Marco R. now and propose Tue/Wed slots. taylor, want to join the initial 30m?
taylor_csm: yes please — try to get a commitment to attend with procurement + new ML lead. I'll prepare a short one-pager: quick wins + rollback/fallback plan.
aj_sales: i'll prep a short commercial note on credits and pilot terms, cc legal after we get verbal.
priya_cs: also asking for their prompt set and any fine-tunes. we'll ask customer to run this quick diagnostic snippet and paste output in thread:
priya_cs: ```bash
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\n  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/diagnostic \\n  -d '{\"account_id\":\"oriondata\",\"sample_days\":7}'
```
ops_bot: reminder: QBR slot available next Tue 11:00-11:30 for exec sync, bookable via /calendar create. :calendar:
marcus_eng: FYI, I see a sudden drop in usage from a handful of IP ranges — might be they disabled automated workflows after Lydia left. no errors in model serving.
taylor_csm: good catch. Priya, if it's workflow disablement, enablement + a short automation runbook should recover ~50% of usage quickly. we'll frame the credits to cover the first week of run.
priya_cs: emailing Marco now. will update here with scheduling + customer notes. tagging @aj_sales for follow-up on credits. :email:
aj_sales: received, will stand by for verbal and then push contract note. :thumbsup:
priya_cs: update 20m later: Marco responded, tentative Wed 10:30. asked for brief on security posture + SSO. adding Lydia's replacement in convo.
taylor_csm: great. I'll draft the one-pager and add a small appendix on fallback models to keep latency stable if they switch vendors.
marcus_eng: putting together the usage export, will drop CSV here when ready.
priya_cs: thanks team — target: get enablement + exec sync done this week, then re-evaluate renewal trajectory. low-touch triage but high priority. :rocket:
